relations.text: Asanaは2024年11月にAWSと、ホスティング関連サービスの60か月契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In November 2024, Asana entered into a 60-month contract with AWS for hosting-related services

source.label: Asana 10-K
source.quote: In November 2024, the Company entered into a 60-month contract with Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) for hosting-related services, which replaced the Company’s prior agreement with AWS and terminated the remaining commitments under the prior agreement.

relations.text: 顧客例としてAmazonが挙げられている
relations.text_en: Amazon is named among Asana's example customers

source.label: Asana 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Over 170,000 customers like Accenture, Amazon, Anthropic, Morningstar, and Suzuki rely on Asana to align teams and accelerate organizational impact.

relations.text: AsanaはOpenAIと戦略的提携を結び、AI機能を支えている
relations.text_en: Asana has a strategic partnership with OpenAI to power its AI features

source.label: Asana 10-K
source.quote: We have expanded this ecosystem through strategic partnerships with leading foundational model providers, including OpenAI and Anthropic, to power our AI features with state-of-the-art intelligence.

relations.text: AsanaはGoogle Cloud Partner of Yearを受賞した
relations.text_en: Asana received the Google Cloud Partner of the Year award

source.label: Asana 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Received the Google Cloud Partner of the Year award, underscoring Asana’s position as a strategic enterprise partner for connecting work management with the broader Google ecosystem.

relations.text: AsanaはMastercardと提携し、Mastercard Business会員に初回の年間契約の20%還元を提供した
relations.text_en: Asana launched a partnership with Mastercard offering Mastercard Business cardholders a 20% rebate on an annual subscription for first-time customers

source.label: Asana 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Launched a partnership with Mastercard, offering Mastercard Business cardholders a 20% rebate on an annual subscription to first-time Asana customers.

relations.text: その後、小規模事業者向けの割引提供へ提携を拡大した
relations.text_en: The partnership was later expanded to give small businesses access to Asana at a discounted rate

source.label: Asana 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Expanded Asana’s partnership with Mastercard - giving small businesses access to Asana at a discounted rate so they can work with more clarity, speed, and impact.

relations.text: AsanaのAPIはMicrosoft Teamsなどの外部アプリと連携できる
relations.text_en: Asana's API enables integration with third-party applications such as Microsoft Teams

source.label: Asana 10-K
source.quote: The Asana platform maintains a robust API that enables developers to build apps and integrate efficiently with hundreds of third-party applications like Microsoft Teams, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
